pipeline_stage: Step 4: Feature Engineering and Transaction Pattern Analysis

time_gap_seconds.description: Seconds elapsed since sender previous transaction

is_off_hours.description: Binary flag for transactions between 11:00 PM and 5:59 AM

is_high_value.description: Binary flag for unusually large transactions (>= ₹50,000 or 2.5x historical)

velocity_score.description: Normalized speed score combining frequency and short time gaps

transaction_risk_indicator.description: Composite heuristic score for transaction suspicion

tx_frequency_total.description: Total combined inbound and outbound transactions

pass_through_ratio.description: Ratio of total money forwarded to total money received

min_turnaround_time_sec.description: Minimum seconds between credit receipt and debit transfer

cross_bank_tx_ratio.description: Fraction of account transactions crossing bank boundaries
